scripts.dev:start: if [ -f .dev.pid ] && kill -0 $(cat .dev.pid) 2>/dev/null; then echo "dev server already running: pid $(cat .dev.pid) http://localhost:5173"; else nohup vite > .dev.log 2>&1 & echo $! > .dev.pid; sleep 1; echo "dev server started: pid $(cat .dev.pid) http://localhost:5173 log: .dev.log"; fi
scripts.dev:stop: if [ -f .dev.pid ]; then kill $(cat .dev.pid) 2>/dev/null && echo "dev server stopped (pid $(cat .dev.pid))"; rm -f .dev.pid; else echo 'dev server not running'; fi
scripts.dev:status: if [ -f .dev.pid ] && kill -0 $(cat .dev.pid) 2>/dev/null; then echo "running: pid $(cat .dev.pid)"; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:5173 >/dev/null && echo 'http 5173 OK' || echo 'http not ready'; else echo 'not running'; fi
scripts.check: npm run type-check && npm run lint && npm run build
